result.brief: 提出几何先验引导的视频到视频扩散框架 GeoV2V，实现轨迹变化下的驾驶场景新视角生成，并构建 Para4D 多车道同步合成数据集。
result.reason: Geometry-grounded video-to-video diffusion for novel-trajectory driving scene synthesis, with dataset and full-video conditioning; contributes to controllable video generation and driving world simulation.
